attributes.context: This is in Article I, Declaration of Principles, and appears alongside the statement that there shall be no limitation on the amount of work a man shall perform during his working day.

extraction_text: That there shall be no restriction in the use of machinery or tools.

attributes.context: The same section generally requires an operating engineer to be in charge of elevators used in new building construction, defines an elevator as a cage or platform raised or lowered by mechanical means, and provides that if any employee is assigned to an elevator it must be an engineer.

extraction_text: If the elevator in a new building being constructed is a push button or automatic elevator and has been certified for public use by the local codes administrator (or other governing agency) and there are five (5) or more floors on which there is actual construction work in progress then an operating engineer is required. If there is four floors or less of actual construction work in progress, then no operator for the elevator shall be required.

attributes.context: The section contrasts this with the general rule that elevators used in new building construction must be operated by an engineer and that any employee assigned to an elevator must be an engineer; it also sets separate engineer requirements for push button or automatic elevators in new buildings based on the number of floors with active construction.

extraction_text: Push button or automatic elevators in existing buildings (rehab or remodel) used for Operating or lowering of material or rubbish and which have been approved for public use shall not require an engineer.

attributes.context: The section otherwise requires engineers for concrete pumps, test or pressure pumps, jets, well point systems, de-watering systems, and steam jennies, and states that an operator may use an unlimited number of pieces of equipment in well point and de-watering systems.

extraction_text: No engineer will be required on the operation of any electric automatic de-watering systems or pumps. If any one is assigned to such equipment it shall be an engineer.

attributes.context: Located in Section 19.2 Hourly Premiums, after listed equipment premium rates and crane certification, in the Operating Engineers Kansas City agreement.

extraction_text: Classification of wages for new equipment shall be negotiated between the Association and the Union within seven (7) days after equipment has been marketed in the area.
